OPT.purpose: optimisation of fixed settings (chance-constrained search, rounding check)

CAL.purpose: calibration and configuration selection of the adaptive policy

VAL.purpose: independent validation of every selected design and policy (used once)

VAL2.purpose: fresh validation, used only if a design fails VAL and is modified by the pre-declared rule

STRESS.purpose: model-form and robustness stress tests (evaluation only, no selection)

acceptance_rule: one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound of P(pass) >= 0.95
